root_cause: The production snapshot exited on a Git-linked Netlify build error before attempting the already-authorized canonical exact-source upload fallback.
fix: Log the linked-build error, mark linked_fallback=true, then continue through canonical exact-source transport. Provider-ready, exact production SHA and browser readback remain mandatory.
prevention: One canonical successor only; close duplicate fallback PRs.
Never treat trigger_build ok=true as LIVE proof.
Never stop on linked-build state=error before canonical exact-source fallback has been attempted.
Exact production SHA and production browser readback remain terminal authorities.
